context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Backend /api/ and /api/status endpoints working. Distance calculation API has external dependency issue (Nominatim geocoding). Frontend loads correctly, login works, all 5 tabs navigate properly (Home, Settings, Stats, Gas, Agenda). No PIN required by default. Main issues are missing testID attributes and deprecated style props (minor).
rca_of_issue: Distance calculation API failure RCA: The /api/distance/calculate endpoint uses Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) geocoding service to convert city names to coordinates. The service is returning empty results for valid cities like 'Milano' and 'Roma', causing the 'Città non trovata' error. This is likely due to: (1) Nominatim rate limiting (1 request per second), (2) Service outage, or (3) Network connectivity issues. The app code is correct - it includes proper User-Agent headers and rate limiting delays. Mitigation: Add caching for frequently used cities, implement fallback geocoding service, or allow manual coordinate input.
